knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Contamination requires stopping, correct re-cleaning and reporting.
Food and personal items are protected before the work starts.
The handover states only what was done and inspected.
The preparation and method section says to confirm the scope, allergies or site restrictions before starting.

practicalCriteria: Confirms scope, allergies and protection of food before starting.
Keeps food-contact and general cleaning separate throughout.
Recovers from a simulated contaminated cloth and records it.
Completes final inspection and hands over with an accurate record.
passRule: All critical safety criteria met and all other criteria demonstrated, observed by an assessor. Reassess gaps after feedback. A quiz result is not evidence of practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation against the critical steps
stopWorkCriteria: Cross-contamination of food-contact surfaces not recovered
Continuing after a serious unmitigated hazard
